about: Increment 1: harmless tools that prove the agent loop, approvals and images. See docs\AGENT.md.

tools.name: get_time
tools.title: Date and time
tools.description: Returns the PC's local date, time, weekday and UTC offset.

tools.name: list_folder
tools.title: List a folder
tools.description: Lists the files and sub-folders in a folder (name, size, last changed). Only folders I allowed can be read; leave path empty for the first allowed folder. The allowed folders are: {{allowedFolders}}

tools.name: read_text_file
tools.title: Read a text file
tools.description: Returns the text of a file inside an allowed folder (text files only, up to {{readMaxKB}} KB).

tools.name: read_clipboard
tools.title: Read the clipboard
tools.description: Returns the text currently on my clipboard.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.title: Take a screenshot
tools.description: Takes a screenshot and attaches it to my next message as an image. monitor: 0 = all monitors in one image (default), 1, 2, ... = only that monitor.

tools.name: show_message
tools.title: Show me a message
tools.description: Shows me a message in a small window on my screen.
